incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PROD-INFER-01 — increased tail latency for text-generation (95p > 400ms)
pagerduty-bot: Paging primary: Sanjay (oncall) — Escalation policy: prod-inference
Sanjay (oncall): acked — looking now, on my phone. seeing a spike in 95p for model:redwood-7b-q4f32 in us-west-2
Sanjay (oncall): logs show lots of transient OOM / gpu-sched delays, possibly KV cache churn. attaching quick tail:```
[2026-03-14T02:15:10Z] WARN model=redwood-7b-q4f32 slot=0 alloc_failed: attempt=3 size=1.2G
[2026-03-14T02:15:11Z] ERROR runtime: kernel stall 120ms
[2026-03-14T02:15:12Z] INFO batching: active_batches=48 avg_tokens=6
```
Maria (sre): Sanjay — you seeing increased queue length on gw nodes or on gpu nodes? can you post the `redwoodctl top` output if possible?
Sanjay (oncall): mobile DND so terse — gw qdepth up, gpu utilization 98% on p4d-podset-2, scaling not kicking (autoscale config mismatch?)
pagerduty-bot: Primary unacknowledged timeout reached (5m) — escalating to secondary: Jamal (ml-infra)
Jamal (ml-infra): acked — hopping in. I can repro via loadtest; looks like bursty prefix traffic thrashing KV cache and forcing frequent recompute.
Olivia (product): any customer impact yet? are live requests timing out or just slow?
Sanjay (oncall): some 504s at edge for high-concurrency routes, error rate ~0.8% for requests hitting redwood-7b-q4f32. Affected customers: a handful of enterprise routes (no PII).
Kevin (manager): I'm awake — paged. If this is a capacity/scaling bug we need fast mitigation and a customer-facing note. @Olivia can you prep a short status note for the affected customers?
Jamal (ml-infra): mitigation plan: 1) route traffic away from redwood-7b-q4f32 to warm fallback redwood-7b-q4f16-rc 2) increase dedicated pool by +2 pods 3) temporarily reduce batch size on heavy routes
Sanjay (oncall): doing quick route change now:```bash
# route fallback for prod inference routes
redwoodctl route set --selector "route:enterprise-*" --fallback-model redwood-7b-q4f16-rc --dry-run=false
kubectl scale deployment/gpu-pool-prod --replicas=12 -n redwood-infer
```
Maria (sre): adding rate-limit at edge for the worst offenders:```yaml
- route: /v1/generate/enterprise/heavy
  rate_limit: 30r/s
```
incident-bot: Action taken: route update applied, kube scale triggered, edge rate-limits pushed.
Jamal (ml-infra): monitoring metrics — 1m after actions, 95p dropped from 420ms -> 180ms, error rate from 0.8% -> 0.12%
Sanjay (oncall): confirmed reduced 504s, but we still see elevated GPU mem alloc/retries — will follow up with quantize flags and kernel tuning later today.
Olivia (product): customer message drafted: "We're investigating intermittent latency on text generation in us-west-2 affecting a small number of enterprise customers. We've applied a mitigation and will provide updates. ETA for full root cause: 24 hours." Want sign-off before sending.
Kevin (manager): good. send now as "investigating, mitigation in place, will follow up". include support link and exec contact.
Jamal (ml-infra): follow-up to do list: 1) run KV-cache warmers for enterprise prefixes 2) investigate autoscaler policy not adding pods 3) evaluate fallback model perf vs quality 4) postmortem owner: Jamal
Maria (sre): I'll open an incident ticket and assign oncall actions + oncall handoff: Sanjay to hand to Jamal in 30m if stable.
Sanjay (oncall): handing off to Jamal in 30 — going to bed, thanks team. :coffee:
Kevin (manager): good handoff. @Olivia please send customer note and @support-team monitor tickets.
incident-bot: Incident status: MITIGATED (short-term) — routing fallback active, autoscale rollback in progress, monitoring 2h for regressions.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note: secondary acknowledged, manager notified. escalation policy closed.
Maria (sre): quick retro notes inline: likely two contributing factors: 1) KV cache eviction under bursty enterprise prefixes 2) autoscaler policy threshold tied to CPU instead of GPU memory usage.
Jamal (ml-infra): agreed. I'll include repro, perf traces, and suggested autoscaler fix in the ticket.
Olivia (product): sent customer note. got a verbal ack from one impacted customer — they appreciate the fast mitigation.
Sanjay (oncall): good night all — Jamal owns the postmortem.
Jamal (ml-infra): I'll keep monitoring and will update here in 2h with RCA draft."
